सुफ꣫ल und सुफल꣫
— 1〉 Adj. (f. सुफ꣫ला und सुफला꣫)
 — a〉 schönfruchtig, fruchtbar

.
 — b〉 mit einer schönen Klinge versehen.
— 2〉 *m.
 — a〉 Feronia elephantum.
 — b〉 Citrone.
 — c〉 Pterospermum acerifolium.
 — d〉 Granatbaum.
 — e〉 Ziziphus jujuba^1.
 — f〉 Phaseolus mungo.
— 3〉 *f. सुफला
 — a〉 [] Momordica mixta.
 — b〉 Gmelina arborea.
 — c〉 Weinstock mit röthlichen Trauben.
 — d〉 Koloquinthengurke

.
 — e〉 Benincasa cerifera^2.
 — f〉 Musa sapientum

.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk, Thomas Malten on 20241207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/PWK/issues/111.
[2] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk, Thomas Malten on 20241207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/PWK/issues/111.
